第63章 赵支书的手段-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》

“赵铁蛋，老子给你脸了是不？”

“来，你过来……！”

李青山轻笑一声，上下打量着村子里的懒汉赵铁蛋，旋即对其招了招手道。

赵铁蛋刚刚可是见识到李青山暴打赵瞎子的模样，哪里敢上去触这个霉头，缩了缩脑袋，退到了村支书身后，不敢再多说废话。

“李青山，那你觉得，这件事情应该怎么解决？”赵支书面露严肃，极力压抑住内心的怒火道。

小崽子，竟然敢公开和自己作对？

别让自己抓住机会，定然要让你在村子里住不下去，以后的日子，可还长着呢！

“公事公办！”

“报政府处理！”

李青山语气平静道。

赵瞎子是个什么东西，李青山很清楚，就是一个懒汉，家里什么都没有的玩意，就一间破房子，家徒四壁的，人也是混吃等死的东西，这样的人自己搜刮不出什么好处，不如直接扭送公安。

赵瞎子这个是故意持刀伤人未遂，尚未达到故意杀人未遂的情况，故意杀人未遂需要对关键部位捅刺，并且多次捅刺的情况，所以不能算作故意杀人未遂，而且李青山身上也没有伤势，最多就是个持刀故意伤人未遂。

正常情况下，短期的拘留吧，而且一般都是村支书调解，村支书调解不行，就乡里来人调解，这个年代不是后世，遇到这种事情直接就报公安，让公安来拿人，毕竟又没出什么大事情，以前村子里这种事情可是多的很，用铁锨，锄头干仗的。

甚至有不少性子野的，拿猎枪去干。

不过，这短期的拘留劳改，也不是舒服的，就赵瞎子这种事情，最起码三个月，得脱一层皮。

现在的劳动教养，可不是后世那么轻松。

有的去修铁路，有的去挖石头，挖矿……！

反正都是体力活，重活，而且吃的也一般，直接当牛马骡子使用，这样才能达到教养的目的，让其以后不要再犯。

李青山这种直接报公安的事情，说实话，在这个年代，还真的是不多。

所以。

当李青山说出这句话的时候，赵支书都有些诧异，眉头紧皱道：“村子里的事情在村里解决，不要闹得太大，对咱们村子的名声也不好，日后人家说起咱们村子，只知道伤人，混乱，不讲理，以后咱们村子的年轻人娶媳妇都受影响，李青山，做人可不能这么自私。”

下一刻。

"Zhao Tiedan, am I giving you face?"

"Come, come here...!"

Li Qingshan chuckled, looked up and down at Zhao Tiedan, the lazy man in the village, and then waved to him.

Zhao Tiedan had just seen Li Qingshan beating Blind Zhao violently, so he didn't dare to go up and get into trouble with him. He shrank his head and retreated behind the village party secretary, not daring to say any more nonsense.

"Li Qingshan, how do you think this matter should be resolved?" Zhao Zhishu said seriously, trying his best to suppress the anger in his heart.

Little brat, how dare you openly oppose yourself?

Don't let yourself seize the opportunity, it will definitely make it impossible for you to live in the village. It will be a long time in the future!

"Business is business!"

"Report it to the government!"

Li Qingshan said calmly.

Li Qingshan knew very well what Blind Zhao was. He was just a lazy man. He didn't have anything at home, just a broken house with bare walls. He was just eating and waiting to die. Such a person couldn't gain anything by himself, so it was better to just send him to the police.

Blind Zhao deliberately attempted to injure someone with a knife, but it did not reach the level of attempted intentional homicide. An attempted intentional homicide requires stabbing a key part and stabbing multiple times, so it cannot be counted as an attempted intentional homicide. Moreover, Li Qingshan had no injuries on his body. At most, it was an attempted intentional homicide with a knife.

Under normal circumstances, it would be a short-term detention, and it would usually be mediated by the village party secretary. If the village party secretary fails to mediate, people from the village will come to mediate. This era is not the future. If you encounter such a thing, you will directly report it to the police and let the police come to pick up the person. After all, it is not a big incident. In the past, there were a lot of such things in the village, and people used shovels and hoes to fight.

There are even many wild-tempered people who use shotguns to do it.

However, this short-term period of detention through labor is not comfortable. For things like Zhao Xiazi, it will take at least three months to shed a layer of skin.

Today’s reeducation through labor is not as easy as it will be in future generations.

Some go to build railways, some go to dig rocks and mine...!

Anyway, it's physical work, heavy work, and the food is mediocre. They can be used directly as cattle, horses, and mules. Only in this way can the purpose of education be achieved, so that they will not do the same thing again in the future.

To be honest, in this era, there are really not many cases where Li Qingshan reports directly to the police.

so.

When Li Qingshan said this, Party Secretary Zhao was a little surprised. He frowned and said, "The issues in the village should be resolved in the village. Don't make too big a fuss. It will also be bad for our village's reputation. In the future, when people talk about our village, they only mean hurtful, chaotic, and unreasonable. In the future, young people in our village will be affected when they get married. Li Qingshan, you can't be so selfish."
